offering_description.value: Provides a cloud-based go-to-market platform combining a database of business contacts and company data with sales and marketing intelligence, engagement and data tools. Sells subscriptions to sales, marketing and recruiting teams at businesses. Data is compiled from proprietary and third-party sources and delivered via web app, integrations and APIs.

primary_products.value: B2B contact and company database platform; sales intelligence software; marketing automation and advertising software; conversation intelligence software; data enrichment APIs

customer_segment.value: B2B: sales, marketing, recruiting and operations teams at companies of all sizes, plus data and technology providers

end_markets.value: software and technology; business services; financial services; healthcare; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual and multi-year subscriptions to platform access, data credits and modules

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud platform built on compiled business data, sold to business sales and marketing teams

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US customers, with customers in Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: B2B data, sales intelligence, marketing, engagement and talent products on one platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: inside and field sales teams selling to businesses; online: self-serve web signup for smaller customers; partners / resellers: CRM and sales tool integrations and data partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules on personal contact data, such as GDPR, CCPA and CAN-SPAM
